$comment: The source strings of every client, in ICU MessageFormat: plain text, {name} arguments and one top-level {count, plural, ...} with # for the count. Every key needs a description for translators; platforms lists the clients that use a string when not all do (web, apple, android, desktop).

nav.home.description: Top-level destination: continue watching, next up and the latest items.

nav.libraries.description: Top-level destination listing the media libraries.

nav.downloads.description: Top-level destination of the items downloaded for offline playback.

nav.profile.description: Top-level destination of the signed-in user, with settings.

nav.settings.description: Screen of the app's and the user's settings.

home.continueWatching.description: Shelf of items whose playback was left unfinished.

home.nextUp.description: Shelf of the next episodes of the series being watched.

home.latest.description: Shelf of the items added last to a library; library is its name.

home.recentlyReleased.description: Shelf of a library's items released last; library is its name.

home.recentlyAired.description: Shelf of the episodes aired last in a library; library is its name.

home.topRated.description: Shelf of a library's best rated items; library is its name.

home.topUnplayed.description: Shelf of a library's best rated items the user has not watched; library is its name.

home.startWatching.description: Shelf of series in a library the user has not begun; library is its name.

home.rediscover.description: Shelf of items the user watched long ago; library is its name.

home.becauseYouWatched.description: Shelf of items like one the user watched; title is its name.

home.becauseYouLike.description: Shelf of items like a favorite of the user; title is its name.

home.moreInGenre.description: Shelf of items of a genre the user watches; genre is its name.

home.starring.description: Shelf of items with an actor the user watches; name is theirs.

home.directedBy.description: Shelf of items by a director the user watches; name is theirs.

home.availableRequests.description: Shelf of the user's requests that became available.

home.trending.description: Shelf of popular titles no server has yet, to request.

home.offline.description: Badge of a shelf shown from what was kept while its server is unreachable.

home.serverUnreachable.description: Placeholder of a server whose shelves cannot be loaded; server is its name.

home.more.description: Action opening all the items of a shelf.

library.sort.description: Button opening the sort options of a library.

library.filter.description: Button opening the filters of a library.

library.itemCount.description: Number of items in a library or list.

library.recommended.description: Tab of a library showing its shelves.

library.all.description: Tab of a library showing the grid of all its items.

item.play.description: Starts playback of an item from the beginning.

item.resume.description: Resumes playback of an item where it was left.

item.favorite.description: Toggles whether the item is a favorite.

item.markUnplayed.description: Marks an item as not watched.

item.seasonCount.description: Number of seasons of a series.

item.episodeCount.description: Number of episodes of a season or series.

item.episodeNumber.description: Season and episode numbers of an episode.

item.minutesLeft.message: {count, plural, one {# minute left} other {# minutes left}}
item.minutesLeft.description: Time remaining of a partly watched item.

item.cast.description: Section listing the people of an item.

item.seasons.description: Section listing the seasons of a series.

item.episodes.description: Section listing the episodes of a season.

item.tracks.description: Section listing the tracks of an album.

item.similar.description: Section of items similar to the one shown.

item.versions.description: Section listing the media files of an item and its copies on the user's other servers.

item.onServer.description: Where an item or one of its versions is; server is the server's name.

item.unplayedCount.description: Badge of the number of unwatched episodes of a series or season.

item.download.description: Downloads an item for offline playback.

item.removeDownload.description: Deletes the downloaded file of an item.

download.waiting.description: State of a download not started yet.

download.paused.description: State of a download interrupted, to be resumed.

download.failed.description: State of a download that failed.

download.progress.description: Progress of a download; received and total are sizes such as 1.2 GB.

download.resume.description: Resumes a paused or failed download.

download.emptyMessage.message: Items you download play here without a connection.
download.emptyMessage.description: Message of the empty Downloads screen.

player.play.description: Accessibility label of the play button of the player.

player.pause.description: Accessibility label of the pause button of the player.

player.seekBack.message: Back {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
player.seekBack.description: Accessibility label of the button seeking backward.

player.seekForward.message: Forward {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
player.seekForward.description: Accessibility label of the button seeking forward.

player.subtitlesOff.description: Subtitle picker choice that shows no subtitles.

player.subtitleOffset.description: Control shifting subtitles earlier or later.

player.pictureInPicture.description: Moves the video into a floating window.

player.chapters.description: List of the chapters of the item.

player.back.description: Accessibility label of the button leaving the player.

player.openExternal.description: Opens the stream in a player such as mpv or VLC.

player.copyLink.description: Copies the stream's address for an external player.

player.mute.description: Accessibility label of the button muting the sound.

player.unmute.description: Accessibility label of the button restoring the sound.

state.empty.description: Title of an empty list or library.

state.error.description: Title of a screen that failed to load.

state.offline.description: Title shown when the server cannot be reached; downloaded items stay available.

action.cancel.description: Cancels a dialog or an action.

action.done.description: Closes a sheet or dialog, keeping its changes.

action.delete.description: Deletes the item it is next to.

auth.server.description: Field of the server's address on the sign-in screen.

auth.username.description: Field of the user name on the sign-in screen.

auth.password.description: Field of the password on the sign-in screen.

auth.quickConnect.description: Signs in by approving a code on a device already signed in.

auth.quickConnectCode.message: Enter {code} on a device that is signed in
auth.quickConnectCode.description: Instruction of Quick Connect; code is six digits.

auth.welcome.description: Title of the first sign-in screen.

auth.setUp.description: Title of the screen creating the first user of a new server; server is its name.

auth.setUpMessage.message: Create the administrator account of this server.
auth.setUpMessage.description: Explanation on the screen creating the first user of a new server.

auth.createAccount.description: Creates the first user of a new server and signs in.

auth.addServer.description: Adds another server to sign in to.

auth.signOut.description: Signs out of a server and forgets it.

auth.signedOut.description: State of a server whose session ended; the user signs in again.

auth.signedInAs.description: The user signed in to a server; name is the user's.

auth.servers.description: Section of the profile listing the servers the user signed in to.

auth.authorizeDevice.description: Section where the user enters a Quick Connect code shown by another device.

auth.authorize.description: Approves the Quick Connect code entered.

auth.authorized.description: Confirmation after approving a Quick Connect code.

auth.notMavio.message: This address is not a Mavio server.
auth.notMavio.description: Error when the address entered answers but is not a Mavio server.

auth.wrongPassword.message: The username or password is incorrect.

auth.moveUp.description: Moves a server earlier in the user's order of servers.

auth.moveDown.description: Moves a server later in the user's order of servers.

auth.nearby.description: Section of the sign-in screen listing the servers found on the local network.

auth.signInWithPasskey.description: Signs in to a server with a passkey of this device or browser.

auth.totpCode.description: Field of the six-digit code of the user's authenticator app.

auth.totpMessage.message: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.totpMessage.description: Explanation when signing in needs the code of the user's authenticator app.

auth.wrongCode.description: Error when a verification code or PIN is wrong.

auth.switchUser.description: Switches the signed-in user of a server, or the section listing whom to switch to.

auth.current.description: Marks the user currently signed in among those to switch to.

auth.pin.description: Field of a user's four-digit PIN.

auth.enterPin.description: Asks for the PIN of the user to switch to; name is the user's.

auth.security.description: Section of the profile with the user's passkeys, authenticator app and PIN.

auth.noPasskeys.description: Shown when the user has no passkeys.

auth.addPasskey.description: Creates a passkey for signing in to the server at this address.

auth.passkeyHost.description: Where a passkey can be used; host is the host name.

auth.passkeysUnavailable.message: Passkeys need a host name over HTTPS.
auth.passkeysUnavailable.description: Why passkeys cannot be added at this address.

auth.totp.description: Heading of the user's TOTP, the second factor of a password.

auth.totpOn.message: Sign-ins with a password ask for a code.
auth.totpOn.description: State of a user who has TOTP.

auth.totpOff.description: State of a user without TOTP.

auth.totpSecret.message: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter its code: {secret}
auth.totpSecret.description: Instruction when setting up TOTP; secret is the key in base32.

auth.openAuthenticator.description: Opens the TOTP key in an authenticator app on this device.

auth.pinMessage.message: A PIN guards switching to you.

auth.setPin.description: Sets or changes the user's PIN.

auth.pinOn.description: State of a user who has a PIN.

search.noResults.description: Shown when a search finds nothing on any server.
